sources.observation: Retrieved official homepage identifies legal entity АО «Банк ЦентрКредит», operating banking services in Kazakhstan, and © 2000–2026 footer. Its mobile bcc.kz download link uses the selected 32×32 SVG with alt bcc.kz жүктеп алу. Source SVG has one #00AB75 rounded-square rectangle and a white path forming nested rounded triangular emblem, no lettering or raster. Independent rsvg reference viewed: complete crisp white emblem on green field, suitable square-cell proportions.
